messages.message: ### Step 1: Source-Reference Alignment & Semantic Analysis Task: Align source tokens to the provided Reference Translation; pick in-context sense + grammatical role. Output: (a) Interpretation Lock FIRST (one bullet per source line): - Line <ID> <copy exact source line> => Locked Meaning (truth-conditions) - If comparative/degree: define entities A,B, relation (>,<,≈), and degree (e.g., "slightly"). - Note: A>B is equivalent to B<A; do not reverse the ordering. (b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 19 Allor fu la paura un poco queta, 20 che nel lago del cor m'era durata 21 la notte ch'i' passai con tanta pieta. Reference Translation (provided): Then was the fear a little quieted which in the lake of my heart had lasted through the night that I passed so piteously.

**Interpretation Lock – FIRST (one bullet per source line)**
- **Line 19** *Allor fu la paura un poco queta,* → **Locked Meaning**: *At that moment the state of fear was reduced to a slightly quieter condition.* - **Line 20** *che nel lago del cor m'era durata* → **Locked Meaning**: *That fear had persisted inside the metaphorical lake of my heart.* - **Line 21** *la notte ch'i' passai con tanta pieta.* → **Locked Meaning**: *The night that I endured was experienced with great pity.*
